admin.domains_desc: The address visitors type to reach the website. Add your own domain, turn on the secure connection, then choose the main domain.
admin.domains_none_in_plan: The current plan has no own domain
admin.domains_limit_none: The current plan has no own domain.
admin.domains_limit_full: The current plan allows :l own domains (with and without www count as 1) — :u used. Remove a domain to add another.
admin.domains_limit_lost: Remove a stopped domain to add a new one.
admin.domains_empty_body: The website runs on a subdomain given by the platform. If you have your own domain (for example yourcompany.com), press “Add your own domain” — you are guided step by step.
admin.domains_st_https_err: Secure connection could not be turned on
admin.domains_st_failing: No longer points to the website
admin.domains_rowst_optional: Not pointed — point it when needed, then press Check
admin.domains_menu_primary_need_https: Turn on the secure connection first, then make it the main domain.
admin.domains_msg_platform: A subdomain given by the platform — the admin is always reachable here; it cannot be removed.
admin.domains_msg_platform_primary: A subdomain given by the platform, and the main domain now — the admin is always reachable here; it cannot be removed.
admin.domains_msg_wait: Point the domain as the table below shows, then press Check. It usually takes a few minutes, at some registrars up to 24 hours — the system checks again every 15 minutes.
admin.domains_msg_wait_remove_on: Removed automatically on :date if still not pointed.
admin.domains_msg_claim: This domain is attached to another website. Add the verification record below to prove you own the domain, then press Check.
admin.domains_msg_verified: The domain is pointed correctly. Turn on the secure connection: the address will start with https:// and show a padlock.
admin.domains_msg_issuing: Usually under 2 minutes. You may leave the page — the bell tells you when it is done.
admin.domains_https_err_notpointed: The domain does not point to the system yet, so it could not be turned on. Check the pointing table, then press Try again.
admin.domains_https_err_notpointed_adv: The certificate authority found no DNS record pointing to the target address.
admin.domains_https_err_elsewhere: The domain points somewhere else. Delete the old record at your registrar, then press Try again.
admin.domains_https_err_elsewhere_adv: An old A or AAAA record still points to another server — delete those records.
admin.domains_https_err_proxy: The domain goes through an intermediary layer, so it could not be turned on.
admin.domains_https_err_proxy_adv: If you use Cloudflare: switch this record to “DNS only” (grey cloud) while turning it on; you can switch it back afterwards.
admin.domains_https_err_caa: The domain's settings block the issuer of the secure connection.
admin.domains_https_err_caa_adv: The CAA record does not allow Let’s Encrypt — add letsencrypt.org to CAA or delete the CAA record.
admin.domains_https_err_ratelimit: Tried many times just now — try again in 5 minutes.
admin.domains_https_err_ratelimit_adv: The certificate authority limits the number of tries per domain.
admin.domains_msg_failing: The domain points somewhere else, no longer to the website. Fix it before :date, or the domain stops working here.
admin.domains_msg_failing_primary: Meanwhile the website runs on the remaining domains.
admin.domains_msg_expiring: :n days left: the domain still does not point to the website and stops working here on :date.
admin.domains_msg_expiring_fix: Fix the records as the table below shows, then press Check again.
admin.domains_msg_lost: Stopped on the website — point it again and press Check to run it again.
admin.domains_msg_active_primary: Visitors open the website at https://:host. The other domains redirect here.
admin.domains_msg_active_other: Visitors who open this domain are sent to :host.
admin.domains_point_title: Point the domain to the system
admin.domains_point_intro: At your registrar (where you bought the domain), add exactly the :n records below. Every record points to the same address:
admin.domains_point_apex_q: Your registrar will not let “@” point to a name?
admin.domains_point_apex_intro: Some registrars do not allow this yet. Choose one of two ways:
admin.domains_point_opt_move_title: Move the domain's records to a provider that supports it (recommended)
admin.domains_point_opt_move_body: The domain stays yours; only the place that manages its records changes. Nothing to fix when the platform changes servers.
admin.domains_point_opt_ip_title: Use the server's number for now
admin.domains_point_opt_ip_body: Works right away, but must be changed when the platform changes servers.
admin.domains_point_ip_warning: The “@” record uses the server's number for now. When the platform changes servers you must change this number — you will be told in advance by the bell and email.
admin.domains_point_advanced_body: “Point by name” is usually called CNAME at registrars; for the “@” record some call it ALIAS or ANAME. “Point by number” is an A record. These are DNS records — the directions for a domain.
admin.domains_point_moved_toast: After moving the records, add the 2 records again at the new place, then press Check.
admin.domains_claim_title: Add a verification record at your registrar
admin.domains_claim_body: Only the domain's owner can add this record. Once verified, the other website is told and the domain moves to this website.
admin.domains_claim_type_hint: At your registrar, choose the record type TXT (text). Then press “Check”.
admin.domains_claim_dlg_title: This domain is attached to another website
admin.domains_claim_dlg_body: If you own the domain, add the verification record below at your registrar, then press Check.
admin.domains_claim_taken_alert: The domain :name was attached to another website by its owner. The website still runs on its other domains; if you own the domain, add it again and follow the steps to prove ownership.
admin.domains_err_redirect_only: This spelling only redirects to the one that runs — choose the spelling that runs.
admin.domains_spelling_need_https: The website cannot run at :alt yet: that spelling has no secure connection.
admin.domains_spelling_need_pointed: The website cannot run at :alt yet: that spelling does not point to the system. Point it, then try again.
admin.domains_toast_twin_proof: :alt is not verified yet: that spelling is attached to another website too and needs a second verification record. Add it, then press Check again.
admin.domains_claim_twin_only: :alt is still attached to another website, so that spelling needs its own verification record below. Add this record, then press “Check again”.
admin.domains_claim_twin_why: :alt is attached to that website too, so that spelling needs this second record. Add both records before you press “Check”.
admin.domains_copy_failed: Could not copy — select it and copy by hand: :text
admin.domains_dlg_name_hint: You may paste a whole address such as https://yourcompany.com. A sub-name such as shop.yourcompany.com works too.
admin.domains_dlg_www_hint_off: The website runs at :n; www.:n redirects here on every page. You can change this later.
admin.domains_dlg_www_hint_on: The website runs at www.:n; :n redirects here on every page. You can change this later.
admin.domains_dlg_preview: The website will run at https://:run — :alt redirects here.
admin.domains_dlg_preview_www_note: You typed www, so the “Use www” switch is on.
admin.domains_dlg_added: Added :name to the list. Next: point the domain to the system.
admin.domains_dlg_added_claim: Added :name — you need to prove you own the domain.
admin.domains_dlg_check_foot: Once pointed, press “Check”. It usually takes a few minutes, at some registrars up to 24 hours — the system checks again and tells you by the bell.
admin.domains_dlg_point_apex_note: No server number is needed. Your registrar will not let “@” point to a name? See what to do in the domain's pointing table after closing this box.
admin.domains_err_invalid_empty: Enter your domain, for example yourcompany.com.
admin.domains_err_invalid_format: This is not a domain yet — use only letters, digits, hyphens and dots, for example yourcompany.com.
admin.domains_err_reserved: This is the platform's domain and cannot be attached. Use your own domain.
admin.domains_err_platform_subdomain: Domains ending in …:root are given by the platform. The website already has :host.
admin.domains_err_already_attached: This domain is already in the website's list.
admin.domains_err_limit_reached: The current plan allows :l own domains — all are used.
admin.domains_err_not_found: This domain was not found in the website.
admin.domains_cf_primary_l1: The website's public address changes from :old to :host.
admin.domains_cf_primary_l2: The other domains, :old included, send visitors to :host on every page.
admin.domains_cf_primary_l3: Google needs a few weeks to show the new address in search results.
admin.domains_cf_www_title: Change the spelling of the main domain?
admin.domains_cf_www_l1: The public address changes from :from to :to.
admin.domains_cf_www_l2: :from redirects to the new address on every page. You can change it back at any time.
admin.domains_cf_remove_l1: The website stops running at :run and :alt. This cannot be undone — to use it again you must add and point it from the start.
admin.domains_cf_remove_l1_one: The website stops running at :run. This cannot be undone — to use it again you must add and point it from the start.
admin.domains_cf_remove_l1_primary: :platform becomes the main domain. Visitors who open :run will not reach the website.
admin.domains_cf_remove_l2: Remember to delete the :n records at your registrar: :labels.
admin.domains_toast_throttle: Checked just now — try again in a few minutes. The system still checks every 15 minutes.
admin.domains_toast_not_pointed: :name does not point to the system yet. Your registrar may need more time — the system checks again every 15 minutes.
admin.domains_toast_claim_ok: Verified that you own :name. The other website has been told. Next: turn on the secure connection.
admin.domains_toast_alt_pointed: :alt now points to the system and redirects to :run.
admin.domains_toast_alt_claim_ok: Verified that you own :alt. The other website has been told; :alt now redirects to :run.
admin.domains_toast_recovered: :name points to the website again and works again.
admin.domains_toast_verified: :name is pointed correctly. Next: turn on the secure connection.
admin.domains_toast_https_on: The secure connection is on for :name — the address starts with https:// and shows a padlock.
admin.domains_toast_primary_set: :host is now the main domain. The other domains redirect here.
admin.domains_toast_spelling_set: The website now runs at :host. The other spelling redirects here.
admin.domains_toast_removed: Removed :name. Remember to delete the 2 records at your registrar.
admin.domains_toast_help_sent: Request sent. Support will reply by email to help point :name.
admin.domains_toast_help_wait: Several requests were sent just now — wait for support to reply, or try again in an hour.
admin.domains_toast_ip_unknown: There is no server number to use for the “@” record. Ask support to point it for you.
admin.domains_locked: This cannot be done while support staff are signed in as a member.
admin.domains_imp_banner: This cannot be done while support staff are signed in as a member. You can still see the domains and the pointing tables.
admin.domains_readonly: You can only view the domains. Adding, checking and removing need the permission to manage domains.
admin.domains_readonly_platform: Your platform role can only view the domains. Adding, checking and removing need the permission to manage websites.
admin.domains_console_banner: Viewing the domains of the website :site from the platform console. Every action is written to the website's log.
admin.domains_noperm_title: You do not have permission to manage domains
admin.domains_noperm_body: The role “:role” cannot manage domains. Ask the website owner for the permission if you need to add or change a domain.
admin.domains_load_error_title: The domain list could not be loaded
admin.domains_load_error_body: The network is slow or the server is busy. Your website still runs normally — press Try again in a few seconds.
admin.domains_offline: You are offline. What you typed is kept — carry on once the connection is back.

provisioning.hostname_not_platform_subdo: The address :host is not a platform subdomain, so nothing was changed. A new website starts on a name like your-site.:base; attach the customer's own domain afterwards with site:domain, where it is verified before it goes live.
provisioning.hostname_pending_verificati: A website is still proving it owns the address :host, so it cannot start a new website and nothing was changed. Choose another address.
provisioning.hostname_owned_by_another_t: The address :host already belongs to another customer's website, so nothing was changed. Check --host, or pass --tenant with the exact name of the customer who owns it.
provisioning.hostname_reserved_label: The name :label is kept for the platform's own services, so nothing was changed. Choose another name for this website, like your-site.:base.
provisioning.sites_limit_reached: Website limit reached: this customer's plan allows :limit and they already have :count. To add another website, move them to a plan that allows more.
provisioning.tenant_required: Choose the customer for this new website: --tenant=<ulid or exact name> for an existing customer, or --new-tenant="Customer name" to create one.
provisioning.tenant_both: Use only one of --tenant (an existing customer) or --new-tenant (a new customer).
provisioning.tenant_not_found: No customer ":reference" was found. Check the ulid or the name; if this is a new customer, use --new-tenant="Customer name".
provisioning.tenant_ambiguous: Several customers are named ":reference": :candidates. Run again with --tenant=<ulid> of the right one.
provisioning.tenant_did_you_mean: No customer is named exactly ":reference". Did you mean: :candidates? Run again with --tenant=<ulid> of that customer.
provisioning.tenant_name_too_long: The customer name is too long: :max characters at most.
provisioning.tenant_name_exists: A customer named ":name" already exists: :candidates. To add this website to them, run again with --tenant=<ulid>. Only if this is a different customer with the same name, add --allow-same-name.
provisioning.tenant_mismatch: The website :host already exists and belongs to customer :tenant, not the one you chose. Run again with --tenant=:tenant.
provisioning.tenant_host_taken: The website :host already exists (customer :tenant), so no new customer was created. To finish that website, run again with --tenant=:tenant.
provisioning.tenant_rerun_needs_tenant: The website :host already exists (customer :tenant). To finish it, run again with --tenant=:tenant.
provisioning.host_invalid: ":host" is not a hostname a website can use. Use letters, digits and hyphens, with at least two parts, e.g. shop.example.vn.
customers.phone_invalid: This phone number cannot be used. Type it as you would dial it, e.g. 0901 234 567, or with the country code, e.g. +84 901 234 567.
